subject.title: feat(ui): make the sidebar agent chip body the menu trigger

question: Should clicking the sidebar agent chip body permanently replace direct conversation resume with a menu-first interaction for both single-agent and multi-agent users?
rationale: Both behaviors are plausible UX choices, but the PR intentionally removes an established primary action and offline shortcut; code review cannot decide that product tradeoff without Control UI owner intent.

options.title: Menu with explicit resume
options.body: Keep the larger menu trigger but add a current-agent resume row that is present even when only one agent exists.

options.title: Accept menu-only behavior
options.body: Intentionally remove direct resume after explicit owner approval and provide browser proof that users can still reach all affected actions clearly.

options.title: Preserve direct body resume
options.body: Retain the existing chip-body resume behavior and improve menu discoverability through a larger separate affordance instead.

recommendation.title: Menu with explicit resume
recommendation.body: Keep the larger menu trigger but add a current-agent resume row that is present even when only one agent exists.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is directly driving this protected Control UI interaction change and is the strongest available product-direction owner in the supplied history.
